arguments.summary: Privilege escalation incident on host 10.0.1.25 (WS-IT-101) via PrintNightmare (CVE-2021-34527) exploit. Attacker leveraged unpatched vulnerability to load malicious DLL through spoolsv.exe, escalating from local user to Domain Admin. Source IP 10.0.5.14 correlated with lateral movement and Cobalt Strike beaconing from another host (WS-FIN-042). Despite detection, containment actions were denied during Admin phase due to policy or workflow gaps.

Containment actions (firewall block, EPP quarantine, IAM disable) attempted but denied due to policy or approval requirements.

level: critical
